summary: Nuveen Municipal Value Fund, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing changes to its investment policies effective October 30, 2026, supplementing its January 7, 2026 Form N-CSR shareholder update. Under normal circumstances the closed-end fund will invest at least 80% of assets in municipal bonds delivering income, adopted under Rule 35d-1 of the 1940 Act. The board may amend this non-fundamental policy without a shareholder vote but must give 60 days' written notice; the federal tax-exemption policy requires majority shareholder approval. No deal, stake, price, or advisor terms are stated. This is a routine policy disclosure, not a special situation; watch for any future tender, activist, or restructuring action.
